reviews.text: I've tried two versions of this cleanser (avocado and lavender), and both are great! I slightly prefer the avocado one because of the scent. A little goes a long way, and it really removes everything, including makeup - my skin feels completely clean without needing a second cleanse. My only note is that it's a bit pricier than some alternatives.
reviews.zh: 我試過呢款潔面產品嘅兩個版本（牛油果同薰衣草），兩款都好好！我因為香味，稍為鍾意牛油果嗰款。只需要少少就夠，而且真係可以清走晒所有嘢，包括化妝——我嘅皮膚感覺好乾淨，唔需要再潔第二次。我唯一要提嘅係，佢比某啲其他選擇貴少少。

reviews.text: Me encantó este producto. Desde los primeros días de uso noté que mi piel se veía más hidratada, suave y con mejor apariencia. Tiene una textura agradable, se absorbe bien y no deja sensación pesada ni grasosa. Además, ha sido muy gentil con mi piel y se ha integrado perfectamente a mi rutina diaria. Definitivamente lo seguiré usando y lo recomiendo.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款產品。由用嘅頭幾日開始，我已經留意到我嘅皮膚睇落更水潤、更柔滑，狀態都更好。質地舒服，吸收得好，唔會有厚重或者油膩嘅感覺。而且佢對我嘅皮膚好溫和，好好咁融入咗我嘅日常護理。我一定會繼續用，亦都會推薦。

reviews.text:
It's the yummiest smelling cleanser I've ever tried🤭 It smells like strawberry sherbet ice cream! It's like aroma therapy for me every time I use it🤤

And about it's cleansing effect — it's so good too! Doesn't dry or strip the skin at all, leaves skin soft and hydrated✨

I'll definitely repurchase it!
reviews.zh:
係我試過最好聞嘅潔面產品🤭 聞落似士多啤梨雪糕！每次用嗰陣，對我嚟講都好似芳香療法咁🤤

至於潔面效果——都好好！完全唔會令皮膚乾或者脫脂，令皮膚柔軟又水潤✨

我一定會再買！

reviews.text: La textura es una experiencia increíble, parece realmente crema batida! Me encanta que es un producto 2 en 1: lo uso como mascarilla un minuto y luego como limpiador. Para mi piel seca y sensible ha sido un descubrimiento maravilloso, porque limpia súper bien pero deja la cara muy hidratada y suave, nada de esa sensación de tirantez. Además, al ser vegano y tener ingredientes naturales, se siente súper gentil. ¡Es mi momento favorito de la rutina!
reviews.zh: 質地好似體驗咁，真係好似奶油打發咁！我好鍾意佢係 2 合 1 產品：我會先當面膜敷一分鐘，然後再用嚟潔面。對於我嘅乾性同敏感皮膚嚟講，係一個好好嘅發現，因為佢清潔得好好，但係令面好水潤、柔滑，完全冇緊繃嘅感覺。而且因為係純素同天然成分，感覺超級溫和。係我個護膚流程中最鍾意嘅時刻！

reviews.text: I’ve been using this product for a few weeks now and I’m honestly impressed. The texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave my skin feeling greasy. My skin feels more hydrated, smoother, and has a healthy glow. I also appreciate that it doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin. Definitely a great addition to my skincare routine!
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢款產品幾個星期，老實講，我真係好欣賞。質地輕盈，吸收得快，唔會令皮膚油膩。我個皮膚感覺更水潤、更滑，仲有健康嘅光澤。我亦都欣賞佢唔會刺激我嘅敏感皮膚。絕對係我護膚流程中嘅一個好好嘅新成員！

reviews.text:
This was very disappointing to be honest, it felt greasy not creamy and I did not feel clean after using it. 
Had to do a couple washes every time and even then…

I mistakenly took it as my only cleanser for a trip and regretted so much 

It smells really nice though
reviews.zh:
老實講，呢款令我好失望，用落感覺係油膩嘅，唔係綿密，用完我都覺得唔乾淨。
每次都要洗幾次，就算咁都……

我一時大意，去旅行時淨係用呢款作為唯一嘅潔面產品，之後好後悔。

不過佢香味好好聞。

reviews.text: Absolutely love the Whipped Vegan Pack Cleanser by Muhwabutter! It has a rich, creamy texture that feels so gentle on the skin yet cleans deeply without drying. My face feels soft, refreshed, and perfectly balanced after each use. A must-try for anyone who wants a nourishing, vegan-friendly cleanser!
reviews.zh: 我好愛 Muhwabutter 嘅 Whipped Vegan Pack Cleanser！質地豐富、綿密，用喺皮膚上感覺好溫和，但又可以深層清潔，唔會令皮膚乾燥。每次用完，我面都感覺好軟滑、清新，平衡得好好。想搵一款滋養、純素嘅潔面產品嘅人，一定要試吓！

reviews.text:
This cleanser has a soft, whipped texture that feels gentle and soothing on my skin. It removes impurities effectively without stripping or drying out my sensitive, acne-prone skin.

After cleansing, my skin feels clean, refreshed, and hydrated. It doesn’t cause irritation or breakouts, making it a simple and reliable option for daily use.
reviews.zh:
呢款潔面產品質地軟綿綿、打發咗咁，用喺皮膚上感覺溫和、舒緩。佢可以有效去除污垢，又唔會令我敏感同易生暗瘡嘅皮膚脫脂或者乾燥。

潔面之後，我嘅皮膚感覺乾淨、清新同水潤。佢唔會引起刺激或者爆痘，係日常使用嘅一個簡單又可靠嘅選擇。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
